blockers.title: Success metrics section is missing
blockers.why: There is no primary metric, baseline, target or guardrail, so nobody can tell whether Team Spaces solved the clutter problem or whether the rollout should proceed.
blockers.fix: Add a metrics table, e.g. a primary metric tied to the "140 projects but works in 6" problem with its current baseline and a target and timeframe, plus a guardrail such as project discovery or cross-team collaboration not dropping.

blockers.title: Visibility and permission behavior is undefined
blockers.why: Non-goals exclude "separate permissions models", but the PRD never says whether non-members can still see or access a space's projects, or who can move projects (R2 has no actor), so engineering could build the wrong access model.
blockers.fix: State explicitly that spaces are organizational only (or not), and define who can create spaces, move projects, and what non-members see, with acceptance criteria.

blockers.title: Unresolved dependencies affect the core UX
blockers.why: The sidebar redesign (Joy, Nov 6) shapes R3 and "Search scoping to spaces" (Ben, Nov 13) is unanswered, so key behaviors aren't specified yet.
blockers.fix: Resolve both before handoff, or state a v1 default (e.g. search stays workspace-wide) and move the rest to a later phase.

improvements: Requirements: add error and edge cases such as a project in multiple spaces, removing a member who owns projects, a team lead leaving, and limits on spaces or members.
Requirements: R1 says "Admins" but scope says membership is managed by "workspace admins and team leads"; clarify how team leads are assigned.
Requirements: add non-functional needs (sidebar performance with many spaces, accessibility).
Scope: add a later-phases list and clarify whether the feature is limited to workspaces over 50 members at GA.
Rollout: add a rollback trigger, a monitoring owner, and enablement (admin docs, support, sales for enterprise accounts).
questions: What metric will define success, and what is its current baseline?
Can a project belong to more than one space?
Do spaces restrict access to projects or only change what appears in the sidebar?
Who can move projects into a space: admins, team leads, or project owners?
